annotationRationale: The method models two percentage counts with one unknown, solves a linear equation with parentheses, and calculates 70% of the resulting group size.
sourceMethod: Followed the official one-variable solution using the number of non-seniors and the total count of students who do not play.

review.mathCheck: There are 234 nonplayers. With n non-seniors, 0.60(500−n)+0.30n=234 gives n=220. The resulting nonplayer counts are 168 seniors and 66 non-seniors, totaling 234; non-senior players number 0.70·220=154, choice B.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of numbered MAA solution 3, using the same nonplayer balance, one-variable equation, and final 70% calculation. All modeling and algebra steps are reconstructible.
review.annotationCheck: Word-problem modeling and percentage calculation are appropriately assessed; solving the parenthesized equation is appropriate supporting knowledge. A systems-of-equations node is unnecessary.
